answer: Filling 20 aliases hence means producing 20 separate sets of claims, which is authoring work rather than a lookup. Because the trellis count is verified against the forge text itself, the vertex audit records each rejection and the operator cannot amortise one paragraph. An answer claiming a deep mechanism must supply at least 3 distinct supporting claims, and the count is checked before grading so shallow text cannot pass by padding. That is 4 dollars per alias. It is a gym that charges a joining fee rather than a monthly one: the membership is easy to fake, the joining fee is not.
